page.useABrowsersSignIn: Use a browser's sign-in for members-only, private and age-restricted videos
page.usedForPlaylistsAndBatches: Used for playlists and batches, and pre-selected in the quality list. A site you've used before starts with the quality you picked there last
page.forAudioOnlyDownloadsMp3: For audio-only downloads. MP3 plays everywhere; M4A is smaller at the same quality; Opus is smallest
page.offEveryVideoBecomesMp4: Off: every video becomes .mp4 for QuickTime and Finder. On: 4K/HDR downloads stay .mkv/.webm as the site serves them — better in VLC and mpv
page.makeVideosPlayOnApple: Make videos play on Apple devices
page.reEncodesTheFewDownloads: Re-encodes the few downloads QuickTime, iMessage and iPhone can't open (VP9/AV1 video, Opus audio) to H.264/AAC. Takes extra time and some quality; skipped when Keep original container is on. On by default on Mac
page.markSponsorSegmentsAsChapters: Mark sponsor segments as chapters, or cut them out (needs ffmpeg)
page.howLongToKeepUploading: How long to keep uploading to the swarm afterwards
page.stopSeedingOnceUploadedDownloaded: Stop seeding once uploaded ÷ downloaded reaches this
page.stopSeedingAfterThisLong: Stop seeding after this long, whatever the ratio (0 = no limit)
page.addedToEveryTorrentComma: Added to every torrent (comma or newline separated). Helps when a magnet's own trackers are dead
page.giveUpOnPeerlessTorrents: Give up on peerless torrents after
page.minutesWithNoPeersBefore: Minutes with no peers before a torrent is marked failed. 0 = never: Prism keeps re-announcing every 5 minutes
page.findPeersOnYourOwn: Find peers on your own network
page.fasterSwarmsButItTells: Faster swarms, but it tells your network this machine accepts connections. Always off while a proxy is set
page.incomingPeerConnectionsAndThe: Incoming peer connections (and the UPnP mapping) use this port
page.n0EngineDefaultLowerIt: 0 = engine default. Lower it on slow or metered connections
page.urlOfABlocklistHttps: URL of a blocklist (https, gz supported). Empty = off
page.videosAndDirectDownloadsRunning: Videos and direct downloads running at the same time
page.torrentsDownloadingAtTheSame: Torrents downloading at the same time. One with no peers or no speed for five minutes stops counting, so the next can start
page.keepRunningWhenTheWindow: Keep running when the window is closed
page.downloadsCarryOnInThe: Downloads carry on in the background; open Prism again from the tray or Dock. Quitting asks first while anything is running
page.automaticRetriesAfterADropped: Automatic retries after a dropped connection or a site's rate limit (rate limits wait minutes, not seconds)
page.howOftenSubscribedChannelsAnd: How often subscribed channels and playlists are checked for new videos
page.perDownloadAppliesWhenA: Per download; applies when a download starts
page.allSeedingAndUploadingTogether: All seeding and uploading together; applies immediately
page.holdOrSlowDownDownloads: Hold or slow down downloads during part of the day
page.hourTheWindowEndsWraps: Hour the window ends; wraps past midnight
page.holdNewDownloadsEntirelyOr: Hold new downloads entirely, or start them slower (torrents are slowed too)
page.capForDownloadsStartedAnd: Cap for downloads started, and torrents running, during the window
page.whichDaysTheWindowApplies: Which days the window applies on. None chosen means every day. A window that runs past midnight belongs to the evening it started on
page.forEveryDownloadUnlessOne: For every download, unless one is set differently in its details
page.happensAMinuteAfterThe: Happens a minute after the last download ends, and only after Prism has actually been working — with a countdown you can call off
page.uploadingCountsAsWorkSo: Uploading counts as work, so nothing happens while a torrent is still seeding
page.queuesWhateverLinkIsOn: Queues whatever link is on the clipboard. Leave empty for none — a shortcut set here is taken from every other app while Prism runs
page.bringsTheWindowToThe: Brings the window to the front from wherever you are
page.videoAndDirectDownloadsFeeds: Video and direct downloads, feeds and update checks go fully through it — use socks5h:// so DNS does too. Torrents send only peer connections through a socks5 proxy (DHT and trackers stay direct), and UPnP is switched off. Thumbnails are fetched through it too, and kept on this machine. Empty = direct
page.forVideoDownloadsAndLink: For video downloads and link lookups. On by default
page.directDownloadsIntroduceThemselvesAs: Direct downloads introduce themselves as a web browser, which many file hosts require. Off = as Prism
page.anyFolderYouPickIncluding: Any folder you pick — including external drives and network shares — is allowed; system folders (Library, AppData, dotfiles) never are
page.howNewDownloadsAreNamed: How new downloads are named. Placeholders: {title} {uploader} {site} {resolution} {date} (the day it was added); a / makes a subfolder. Torrents keep their own names
page.takeEachFinishedDownloadOut: Take each finished download out of the working folder. Torrents move once seeding ends, and nothing is ever overwritten
page.sortDownloadsAsTheyArrive: Sort downloads as they arrive: the first category whose rules match gives a download its folder and file names. Leave a box empty to use the defaults
page.name: Name
page.tagsYouPutOnA: Tags you put on a download by hand, several at a time. They group things after the fact and change nothing about where a download goes
page.dropATorrentFileInto: Drop a .torrent file into one of these and Prism offers to add it. Other files are left alone; handled .torrent files are renamed, never deleted
page.playASoundWhenA: Play a sound when a download finishes
page.whenPrismRegainsFocusCheck: When Prism regains focus, check the clipboard for a video link and offer a one-click fetch. Off = Prism never reads the clipboard on its own
page.checkForANewVersion: Check for a new version on launch and offer to install it
page.onceADayCompareThe: Once a day, compare the downloader engine with the newest yt-dlp release
page.installANewerYtDlp: Install a newer yt-dlp as soon as the daily check finds one
page.sendAnonymousCrashReportsTo: Send anonymous crash reports to help fix bugs. Off by default; no personal data or download history is included
page.clearWhereYouStoppedIn: Clear where you stopped in each video (with its file name) and the recent files list. Your files and the Library aren't touched
page.saveTheInAppDiagnostic: Save the in-app diagnostic log as JSON, to attach to a bug report
page.everyPreferenceDownloadLocationProxy: Every preference — download location, proxy, quiet hours, per-site quality memory — goes back to its default. This can't be undone.
page.subtitle: Configure Prism preferences
page.ffmpegMissing: Without it, high-quality merges, embedded thumbnails/chapters, and SponsorBlock won't work. Prism ships its own copy on macOS, so if it's missing there, reinstalling Prism restores it. On Windows install winget install Gyan.FFmpeg, on Linux your distro's ffmpeg package — then restart Prism.
page.dhtProxyOff: Off while a proxy is set: DHT can't go through it
page.dhtDescription: Find peers without a tracker. Off = tracker-only
page.utpProxyOff: Off while a proxy is set: uTP can't go through it
page.utpDescription: Accept and make uTP connections alongside TCP (still maturing in the engine)
page.watchIsDownloads: That’s where Prism saves downloads. Pick a different folder to watch.
page.upToDate: You are on the latest version
page.installing: Downloading and installing update — Prism will restart shortly...
page.installed: Update installed! Please restart Prism to apply.
page.engineCurrent: yt-dlp {{version}} — update when sites stop working
page.engineHint: Update the yt-dlp engine when sites stop working
page.disclaimer: Prism is a general-purpose video download utility. Users are responsible for ensuring they have the right to download any content. Do not use Prism to circumvent DRM or access restrictions.
page.moveToLabel: Move finished downloads to: {{path}}. Choose a folder
page.audioQualityDescription: For audio-only downloads, unless you pick another in the download's details. Original keeps the site's own audio; MP3 plays everywhere; M4A and Opus are smaller at the same quality

cookies.text: Some videos need a signed-in session. Prism lets yt-dlp borrow that browser's cookies for the request on this machine; they are never uploaded anywhere else.

container.text: The container (.mp4, .mkv, .webm) wraps the video and audio streams. Remuxing re-wraps them without re-encoding — fast and lossless — but VP9 and AV1, the codecs sites use for 4K and HDR, play poorly inside .mp4 in QuickTime.

sponsorblock.text: A community database of sponsor, intro and self-promotion segments in YouTube videos.

ratio.text: Uploaded ÷ downloaded. A ratio of 1.0 means you have given the swarm back as much as you took.

trackers.text: A tracker introduces peers to each other; its announce URL is where a client reports in, e.g. udp://tracker.example.org:1337/announce.

dht.text: Distributed Hash Table: finds peers through other clients instead of a tracker. Most magnet links depend on it.

lsd.text: Local Service Discovery: finds peers on your own network by multicast.

utp.text: Micro Transport Protocol: a UDP transport that backs off when your connection is busy, so torrents don't swamp everything else.

upnp.text: Universal Plug and Play: Prism asks your router to open a port so peers can connect to you directly.

blocklist.text: A list of IP ranges (the P2P/eMule format uTorrent and qBittorrent use) the torrent engine will refuse to connect to.

proxy.text: socks5h:// sends DNS lookups through the proxy as well; socks5:// resolves names on this machine first, which can reveal the sites you visit.

ipv4.text: Many sites throttle or block downloads over IPv6. Turn this off only if your network has no IPv4.
